summary: MOBILE Support Plan Reviewer async migration VERIFIED LIVE on the Expo web preview at /tool/care-plan-reviewer as cathy@example.com. Full happy path passed: (1) care-plan-form loaded, cp-text accepted the Dorothy Smith care-plan paste; (2) tapping cp-submit immediately rendered cp-progress; (3) while cp-progress was visible, cp-pick-files and cp-take-photo both reported aria-disabled=true (attach locked during the run) — before submit and after result they were re-enabled (aria-disabled=None); (4) cp-result appeared after 34.4s — no gateway/504 timeout — and included cp-preview (teal tint), cp-plan-summary (clay/gold panel), cp-verification-panel (sage tint) with 5 checks (cp-check-*), and cp-file-findings with 9 findings (cp-finding-*). This closes the iteration_285 parity flag: mobile now uses the async job + polling flow (POST /public/care-plans/review-async → poll /public/care-plans/review-jobs/{job_id}) just like web.
critical_code_review_comments: CarePlanReviewer.tsx (mobile) is now ~475 lines and healthy — single responsibility per section. Async polling pattern (pollReviewJob) is well isolated with correct error handling: it re-throws ApiError with 4xx status, tolerates transient 5xx up to 8 consecutive errors, and gives a friendly timeout after 80×3s tries. No changes required.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing cathy fixture and pasted care plan text from the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Support Plan Reviewer now fully mirrors web: async job + polling, attach controls disabled during progress, cp-progress → cp-result within ~35s for a short text paste. iteration_285 parity flag is closed.
